items.title: UPS to acquire Australian healthcare specialist Smartway Logistics
items.summary: UPS continues to invest heavily in healthcare logistics, announcing on Tuesday a deal for Australia-based Smartway Logistics. The post UPS to acquire Australian healthcare specialist Smartway Logistics appeared first on FreightWaves.

items.title: A 67-Year-Old With $750,000 in Pfizer, Enterprise Products and UPS Collects $3,765 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, a hypothetical $750,000 portfolio split evenly across Pfizer, Enterprise Products Partners and UPS pays about $45,200 a year in dividends, or about $3,760 a month. Enterprise Products Partners’ distribution looks the safest of the three, covered 1.

items.title: A 66-Year-Old Swapped QYLD for JEPQ in a $1.27 Million Portfolio. Here’s What Happened to His $8,467 Monthly Paycheck
items.summary: One retiree dumped a famous 12% yield fund for a rival that pays nearly the same, and the real difference has nothing to do with this month's check. The gap shows up years later, when inflation starts taking its cut.

items.title: United Parcel Service Shows Huge, Unusual Call Option Activity Today - Is UPS Stock Undervalued or Near a Peak?
items.summary: A Barchart report shows unusually heavy call option volume in United Parcel Service stock that expires in 3 months. It recently delivered strong earnings. Investors may be shorting UPS calls and call credit spreads.

items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Predicting United Parcel Service Stock Will Climb or Sink?
items.summary: United Parcel Service has outpaced the broader market over the past year, and analysts remain moderately optimistic about the stock's prospects.

items.title: 5 High-Yield Dividend Stocks to Buy in December With Yields Up to 7.3%
items.summary: Five dividend payers, five sectors, and one question after earnings season: whose payout is actually covered? One casino landlord, one fund manager, and a parcel carrier all face tests that the yield alone will not reveal.
